_about: PRE-VERIFICATION of the tidal candidates (pipeline/tools/audit/tidal_preverify.py): each candidate's proposed tidal point (DFO tidal polygon crossing + words) held against an independent DEM tidal limit (Terrarium z13 streambed min-envelope crossing the threshold). A badge for the review app, never a mark; the owner still accepts each one.
method: DEM tidal limit: Terrarium z13 sampled every 25 m along the FWA line from the mouth; streambed = min of everything within 500 m upstream; limit = first measure above 4 m; agree within max(300 m, 25% of the proposal's distance above the mouth); unchecked when a ±1.5 m threshold error moves the limit more than the tolerance (low gradient)
